substantive_difference: Closure receipts and per-operation tickets own completion/cancellation rather than original module closure; departure flush moved from view-owned task to separate BufferBank service, view Badge owns cleanup only

mechanism_mapping.relationship: latest-edit precedes quiet-interval-expiry, which precedes one write
departing-document pending commit precedes navigation return
view retirement precedes notifications generated by handoff
nested navigation supersedes outer handoff before the outer call returns
preview hide precedes discard and no later publication of that query
consume pending batch invalidates its old timer execution
retire old batch precedes invoking callback that may enqueue new work
last preview query precedes publication by the authorized quiet interval

environment_assumptions.entry_ownership: Document persistence / transient save badge / latest navigation request
environment_assumptions.bound_identities: Per-batch document id, view subscription identity, new navigation request
environment_assumptions.event_and_completion_order: coalesce latest120ms; departure detach -> consume/flush -> inline callback -> guarded install; cancel pending before callback allows callback-created batch
environment_assumptions.invalidation: Consumed timer and retired view; superseded navigation; preview hide
environment_assumptions.preserved_effects: Reopen text and new batches, active badge, preview40ms/discard
environment_assumptions.forbidden_effects: lost/retargeted/duplicate text, late badge, erased reentrant batch, outer navigation overwrites
environment_assumptions.runtime_boundary: Actual target code owns application state and callbacks. Explicit timer/barrier/manual resolve controls legal schedules; no sleep-based races.

semantic_differences: Native ports use actual native operation callbacks and actual runtime Future where available; explicit scheduler replaces browser event queue. JS framework ports use actual mounted component/data lifecycle. No claim of identical unrelated runtime semantics.

candidate_evidence_locations.excerpt: Hotel coordination — A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge. Save callbacks can synchronously navigate. Preview is transient and owns a different quiet interval. Document-buffer responsibility: separate BufferBank service

createWorkspace offers open(id), edit(text), close(), dispose(); createSearchPreview offers query(text), hide(). Store read/write/subscribe is synchronous; timer schedule(callback,delay), cancel(handle) is explicitly controlled. Document buffers are owned by a separate BufferBank service, while Badge owns only a live subscription. A store listener may call navigation synchronously. All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics.
